test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which state has the highest reserves of graphite in India, as of April 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **According to a 2013 assessment by the Geological Survey of India**, **Arunachal Pradesh has 43%** of the country's graphite resources, f**ollowed by Jammu and Kashmir (37%), Jharkhand (6%), Tamil Nadu (5%), and Odisha (3%)**
 
• **Graphite **is a kind of** crystalline carbon that occurs naturally.**
 
• The mineral graphite can be found in metamorphic and igneous rocks.
 
• **It is very soft, cleaves easily, and has a very low specific gravity.**
 
• It is the **only nonmetal that is a good electrical conductor.**
 
• Because of its greasy texture, it is also known as a dry lubricant.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Geological Survey of India is a Government of India Organization under the Ministry of Mines.
 
• The headquarters of the Geological Survey of India is in Kolkata.
 
• The Director-General of the Geological Survey of India is Rajendra Singh Garkhal.
 
• The head of the Ministry of Mines is Prahlad Joshi.
 
• Regional offices of GSI in India are Lucknow, Jaipur, Nagpur, Hyderabad, Shillong and Kolkata.
